feeds.title: Jolene's Tea House Blog
feeds.description: All our teas are 100% organic and hand-blended in Jolene's tea studio in Banff, Canada. Check our blog regularly to read the latest news, and recipes and to find out about our exciting events, where we share what we know about tea, health benefits, recipes, ceremony, our values, and our life in the Rocky Mountains.

feeds.title: Four O'Clock Blog
feeds.description: Live an unprecedented tasting experience with Four O'Clock, where we'll accompany you to an unprecedented tasting experience while feeling the benefits of our teas and herbal teas. Learn how to infuse different kinds of teas and coffees into your lifestyle on our blog page.

feeds.title: Distinctly Me and Tea
feeds.description: Peter Barker & his wife Joyce created Distinctly Tea - tea shoppes with stores in Waterloo and Stratford, Ontario, Canada. One of the most extensive and freshest selections of Oolong, Matcha, Herbal Teas, Tisanes, Black and more. Read Recipes, Tea brewing tips, Tea and Your Health, Product Announcements, Promotions and Unique Tea Gift Ideas.

feeds.title: The Tea Girl Blog
feeds.description: The Tea Girl is an online tea retailer. Local tea flavours, loose tea and matcha purveyor. We only sell tea online and through our wholesale. Educate yourself by reading our blog, where we speak on different aspects of tea.

feeds.title: Steep Thoughts Blog
feeds.description: David's Tea (as we're often searched) is a premium tea retailer devoted to uncompromising customer service and the proliferation of the world's finest teas. The latest count puts us past 150 different teas. DAVIDsTEA Blog! A collection of tea recipes, tutorials and behind-the-scenes information.

feeds.title: MATTCHA'S BLOG
feeds.description: This a blog that is authored by Matt but is yours and the teas as much as it is his. Mattcha's blog shares all about tea through his blog posts. He educates in life and tea, by talking about different teas that should be used for when, how and why.

feeds.title: Tea Journey
feeds.description: Tea Journey is a mobile, multi-media magazine that helps consumers discover fine tea, make informed tea selections, cultivate greater enjoyment and appreciate the art of tea. Tea Journey encourages readers to discover and refine their taste in tea.

feeds.title: The Tea Haus
feeds.description: The Tea Haus is a premium loose-leaf tea merchant in the heart of downtown London & Ontario. We carry a variety of over 200 teas, herbal infusions, and teaware. Welcome to The Tea Haus blog - a place where tea lovers come to discover facts about tea, fresh new recipes, answers to their questions, and more.

feeds.title: The Cup of Life
feeds.description: The Cup of Life is a blog by Lu Ann. A tea blog to help you slow down + savour your tea moments and the simple things in life. Stay up to date with new tea articles, recipes, fun giveaways, special offers and more

feeds.title: Grand River Tea Blog
feeds.description: Here at Grand River Tea, we source amazing tea from North America and around the world. We share different kinds of tea knowledge on our blog, feel free to read.

feeds.title: JUSTEA Blog
feeds.description: JusTea offers the first and only farmer-direct tea from Kenya. We partner with small-scale tea-farming families and communities to ensure that the farmers are paid a fair wage. Learn how to steep tea, how to make iced tea and the health benefits of tea!

feeds.title: Amoda Blog
feeds.description: We've got your body, mind, and mood covered with our different blends of tea. Amoda Tea shares the benefits of matcha, herbal tea, and more on our wellness blog. View the guide to all things tea and healthy living here.

feeds.title: Sloane Fine Tea Merchants Blog
feeds.description: Sloane is a fine tea merchant that sources directly from tea gardens & hand blends in small batches. The Sloane Blog is the place to go for inspiration and see what is new at Sloane Fine Tea Merchants. Try our tea in a whole new way!

feeds.title: Lady Bakers Tea Blog
feeds.description: Lady Baker's Tea sells premium loose-leaf teas, that are ethically produced at the finest tea gardens in Asia and Africa. Approx 50 varieties for every taste and occasion. Different pairings with tea are shared on our blog.

feeds.title: Clearview Tea Co. Blog
feeds.description: Clearview Tea Company is a retailer and wholesaler of premium loose-leaf tea. Our Schomberg location houses our small-batch blending studio as well as a gift shop showcasing local makers and fellow women-led businesses. Learn different infusions, pairings, blends and more.

feeds.title: Genuine Tea Blog
feeds.description: Genuine Tea is redefining tea straight from Toronto's farm to a cup tea company. Delivering high-quality, fresh tea to you while providing fair compensation for farmers. Creative ways to inculcate tea in your daily life are seen through our blog.

feeds.title: Silk Road Tea Blog
feeds.description: Silk Road is your one-stop wellness destination - both inside & out. Find expertly blended Fresh, Organic Tea, Skincare & Bodycare products. Silk Road Tea Blog offers a range of tips, ideas, recipes and much more.

feeds.title: Cup of Té Blog
feeds.description: Cup of Té is a premier online retailer of loose-leaf organic teas and teaware. We offer teas and tea accessories to help you make the perfect cup or great tea lover's gift! Our blog is filled with ravishing tea recipes.
